svg.title: Rulesets Stack: the Strictest Requirement Wins
svg.desc: An organization ruleset requiring two approvals and a repository ruleset requiring one approval plus code owner review combine into two approvals and code owner review.
svg.text: Rulesets Stack: the Strictest Requirement Wins
Everything that applies to a branch is combined; nothing overrides anything.
Layers in too, if one exists
Combined: 2 approvals and code owner review
Most restrictive version of each rule; no priority order
